Upper Text: [End of Your Turn] By deleting this Digimon that has a digivolution card with [Bird] or [Avian] in one of its traits, at the end of your opponent's turn, you may play 1 [Ravemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Falcomon] or [Keenan Crier] from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
